title: MEIKO — Heat's My Game〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem awfully happy, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course I'm happy.
The girls just got their first solo show scheduled.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've been working so hard since even before going pro. I'm ecstatic that their efforts are paying off.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They just keep getting better and better as performers. Plus, this is their first solo show as professionals, so they seem incredibly motivated.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be a fantastic show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They were saying how they want to use all the right effects.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and they were discussing the show's overall concept too. They seem determined to make sure the audience goes home smiling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I really can't wait.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll have to give them as much support as we can, so they can focus on putting on a great show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, its overall concept...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What would you two choose if you could put on your own solo shows?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well, in my case...
I'd want to put on a show where I get to sing with everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sing with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Depending on the song, I'd also want them to just listen... But for others, I'd want them to sing along.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By singing together, I'm sure we could share all our feelings together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful!
I'd also love to do a show where we all sang with each other. It's such a great way to unite the venue!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about you, KAITO? Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd just want to play music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not very good at interacting with the audience... But I can share my feelings with others through my music, at least.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A conversation through music and sound, then. I think it'd be a wonderful expression of who you are, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, MEIKO, that just leaves you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right! I...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd want to put on a high-energy show. One which makes the audience shout so loud that they shake the whole venue!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you mind telling us your reasons?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are a lot... But people who came to my solo show would be there to see me, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I want them all to say, “MEIKO really does put on the best shows! I definitely want to see another one!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I think I'd want to put on a show which gets everyone involved.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Involved...? Involved how?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I could do call-and-response sections during songs...
Oh, and ask for requests directly from the audience!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And then I'd sing their requests right then and there.
That'd be a great way for us to build a show together, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound like fun.
I'm sure it'd be an unforgettable show for them and for you too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly! So, if I were to do a solo show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd want to build an amazingly high-energy show with the audience!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That'd probably be my concept.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's so wonderful. It's very like you to want to do things together with the audience, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Actually, I feel like playing something now.
Why don't we have ourselves a little session?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure. What do you say, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll join.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Then, why don't we celebrate the girls' solo show by playing Blue Moments?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I like it.
Can you count us in?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Here we go, you two!
